grammar_controls.actual_rule: Genitive/construct relation: determining noun follows immediately; construct ending-a, with actual exceptions described. Supports king of kings, generation-of-generation and footstool of your feet without changing observed source endings.

Second-person independentአንተ and actual second-person masculine singular suffixከ; suffix pronouns attached for noun-genitive relations. Read complete149 from338bottom through341opening. These control you/your; no presumed lemma fills the final Kaf.

Singular noun binding vowel and nominative/accusative suffix attachment; actual continuations were viewed. Do NOT claim that this rule alone proves a printed vowel or explains away initialMaiVI in the throne word.
Subject and noun/adjective predicate can be juxtaposed without a written be. Supports blessed are you and heavens are your throne / earth is footstool; English are/is does not add a Geʿez verb.

Several subjects joined by conjunctions may have singular agreement, even when the predicate follows, though plural is usual. This allows the selected singularይነብር with the three coordinated attributes rather than editing the verb. Relevant paragraph crosses501bottom to502.
